summary: Comprehensive testing of Pedagogical Resources bug fix. All backend tests (16/16) passed. All frontend UI tests passed. The bug fix is working correctly - Excel students can now see pedagogical resources (supports and evaluations) in 'Mon parcours' tab. Locked resources appear grayed out with 'Verrouillé' badge, unlocked resources show green 'Télécharger' button.

issues: Console warning: nested button elements causing hydration error (non-blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: Bug fixes verified: 1) Backend now uses current_user.id instead of current_user.student_id
Bug fixes verified: 2) Backend uses case-insensitive parcours matching with 'any/in' pattern
Bug fixes verified: 3) Frontend shows pedagogical resources even when studentResources (tests) is empty
Bug fixes verified: 4) Backend download endpoint uses matched_parcours instead of raw parcours
Admin can manage resources via 'Gérer les ressources' button in ÉLÈVES tab
Unlock/lock functionality works correctly with proper toast notifications
seed_data_creation: Unlocked 'excel-module-35h' resource for Test Excel Student during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pedagogical resources feature is fully functional. Excel students see resources in 'Mon parcours' tab. Admin can unlock/lock resources via 'Gérer les ressources' modal in ÉLÈVES tab. Resources show as grayed with 'Verrouillé' badge when locked, and with green 'Télécharger' button when unlocked.

bug_fix_verification.original_bug: Pedagogical resources (Excel supports and evaluations) were completely invisible to Excel students instead of appearing grayed/locked
root_causes_fixed: Backend used 'current_user.student_id' which doesn't exist on User model - changed to 'current_user.id'
Backend used exact parcours match instead of case-insensitive substring match
Frontend hid pedagogical resources section when studentResources (tests) was empty
Backend download endpoint used raw parcours as dict key instead of matched_parcours
